title: check_message_digest: convoluted OctetString round-trip via DER
description: verify.rs check_message_digest uses: .and_then(|v| OctetString::from_der(v.to_der().ok()?.as_slice()).ok()) to extract OctetString from an AttributeValue. The double .ok()? chain converts two distinct failures into None. This works but is hard to read — a reader cannot tell at a glance whether .ok()? is swallowing a legitimate error or handling an expected None. Rewrite as: let v = md_attr.values.iter().next().ok_or_else(|| SmimeError::Other("empty messageDigest"))?; let der = v.to_der()?; let os = OctetString::from_der(&der)?; This surfaces errors explicitly rather than silently converting to None.
